title: NORMAD: A Framework for Measuring the Cultural Adaptability of Large Language Models
findings: Models demonstrated a performance skew, showing stronger adaptability to norms from English-speaking and European cultures over those from African-Islamic cultures. This 'western-centric' bias was observed across different contexts and model architectures.
